# Route 1 Cascade Decision

- **Date:** 2026-08-27
- **Trigger:** R1 FAIL on real Kodak-24 (+194.22% median NET, threshold <= -5.0%)
- **Decision:** Cascade from Route 3 to Route 1 per blueprint cascade table
- **Rationale:** Route 3 skeleton only had position-only MA-tree features and
  combined all planes into a single ANS stream. The model blob + bypass data
  overhead overwhelmed any clustering benefit at Kodak image sizes. Route 1
  fixes both root causes:
  1. Full v1 features (QG, band_class, activity, position) for proper MA-tree clustering
  2. Per-plane ANS encoding to preserve per-plane statistics
- **Scope:** Route 1 retains Prism v1's MED prediction and ZFF tokenization,
  adds multi-pass with transmitted histograms + static ANS + MA-tree clustering.
  Attacks B1 (collection layer ~6.30%) and B2 (per-image conditioning ~1.5-2.5%).
  Does NOT attack B3 (predictor headroom) or B5 (tokenization) - those remain
  closed under ZFF.
- **Projected outcome:** ~9.33 summed (M2 PASS expected). M3 at risk.
- **Status:** Implementation complete, all 193 tests pass, byte-exact round-trip
  verified. Next: measure on real Kodak-24 to validate Route 1 improvement.

- the Builder
